opportunities.title: Surface and fiber predictions in compressed or highly curved areas
opportunities.why_it_matters: Scroll 2/3 high-value candidates often sit in hard geometry where plain ink inference stays low confidence.
opportunities.next_action: Route high-occupancy, high-fiber candidates to Lasagna preprocessing before ink inference.

opportunities.title: Methods for generating surface, fiber, or ink labels
opportunities.why_it_matters: Creates better supervision and review evidence for non-metal ink signals in Scrolls 2-3.
opportunities.next_action: Convert top occupancy-aware candidates into a label-generation worklist for Lasagna and Crackle review.

opportunities.title: VC3D integrate fiber predictions
opportunities.local_hook: predict.py fiber outputs + VC3D-compatible Zarr metadata
opportunities.why_it_matters: Turns Autoresearch fiber predictions into a community-usable VC3D review layer.
opportunities.next_action: Export fiber maps beside ink maps as VC3D OME-Zarr overlays and document the viewer workflow.

opportunities.title: Whole-volume deformation from vertical fibers and large meshes
opportunities.why_it_matters: Improves surface geometry and deformation correction, a blocker for legible Scroll 2/3 text.
opportunities.next_action: Prototype a deformation review metric that compares fiber coherence before/after registration.

opportunities.title: Scroll-specific 3D augmentations for model training
opportunities.why_it_matters: Targets cross-scroll generalization, the core weakness for First Letters and Title submissions.
opportunities.next_action: Run ablations over aug_scroll_decohesion_p, aug_scroll_squeeze_p, aug_scroll_z_dropout_p, and aug_scroll_intensity_drift_p.

opportunities.title: vc_render_tifxyz OME-Zarr metadata scales
opportunities.why_it_matters: Correct scale metadata is a direct submission requirement because images need accurate 1 cm scale bars.
opportunities.next_action: Add a scale-metadata regression test using our prize artifact validator as the oracle.

opportunities.title: Accurate 3D ink labels
opportunities.why_it_matters: Aligns our model outputs with official 3D labeling and reproducible inference expectations.
opportunities.next_action: Extend the optimized-inference smoke test to cover upstream 3D decoder model contracts.
